data.other_hard: must have successfully completed a bachelor's or master's degree with the University of London Worldwide through distance or flexible learning programmes; must be qualified as a graduate by the University; full degree required (Postgraduate Diploma or Certificate not eligible); not for PhD level; studies must begin in or after 2016/17 academic year for bachelor's and master's; cannot be claimed for a degree already completed
data.evidence_sentence: To be eligible for an Alumni Bursary, you must have successfully completed a bachelor's or master's degree with the University of London Worldwide through its distance or flexible learning programmes.
data.notes: Discount is typically 10% off registration, exam entry, resit and module fees, and it is applied after an offer is received and a bursary code is issued. Page states no nationality, GPA or field restrictions. Bursary requests are processed on a rolling basis; recommended to request at least 2 weeks before registration deadline. Separate SAS (15%/10%) and ULIP alumni discounts are mentioned but are not part of this bursary's criteria. Bursary may be partly repayable on withdrawal. Page does not state a funding amount beyond the percentage discount.
